basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old marketing assistant living in Atlanta, GA. I've recently discovered Reddit and I'm loving it! In my free time, I enjoy cooking with my Le Creuset collection, catching up on the latest in Impact Wrestling, and experimenting with RGB lighting setups for my gaming PC. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy socializing at local wrestling events and online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Marketing from a local college, and I am very interested in digital content creation. I am self-taught in the world of professional wrestling fandom, having followed the sport since my teens. My culinary skills are a hobby, inspired by online cooking channels and foodie subreddits.
